DefaultChoiceDisplayText.SourceString: Two triangles separated by a line?
DefaultChoiceDisplayText.LocalizedString: Two triangles separated by a line?

DefaultChoiceDisplayText.SourceString: No, I don't have time for that
DefaultChoiceDisplayText.LocalizedString: No, I don't have time for that

Message.SourceString: Unless you wish to be forged into a KotHaar, which is likely impossible, there is nothing more for you here.
Message.LocalizedString: Unless you wish to be forged into a KotHaar, which is likely impossible, there is nothing more for you here.

Message.SourceString: But I will say that I admire your skill, human.
Message.LocalizedString: But I will say that I admire your skill, human.

Message.SourceString: What a day, eh? Well, I guess I'm a KotHaar Core now. A tiny marble. But at least I've not being puppeted by a giant dragon, right?
Message.LocalizedString: What a day, eh? Well, I guess I'm a KotHaar Core now. A tiny marble. But at least I've not being puppeted by a giant dragon, right?

Message.SourceString: These are huge and... on fire. I wonder why they are here?
Message.LocalizedString: These are huge and... on fire. I wonder why they are here?

Message.SourceString: Zi is inside. But I warn you - he is changed.
Message.LocalizedString: Zi is inside. But I warn you - he is changed.

Message.SourceString: These are huge and... on fire. I wonder why they are here?
Message.LocalizedString: These are huge and... on fire. I wonder why they are here?

Message.LocalizedString: These are huge and... on fire. I wonder why they are here?

Message.LocalizedString: These are huge and... on fire. I wonder why they are here?

Message.LocalizedString: These are huge and... on fire. I wonder why they are here?

Message.LocalizedString: These are huge and... on fire. I wonder why they are here?

Message.SourceString: These are huge and... on fire. I wonder why they are here?
Message.LocalizedString: These are huge and... on fire. I wonder why they are here?

Message.SourceString: Could you do me a favour and take me to the Bouncer outside of the cave? I've got a bit of house-keeping to do.
Message.LocalizedString: Could you do me a favour and take me to the Bouncer outside of the cave? I've got a bit of house-keeping to do.

Message.SourceString: These are huge and... on fire. I wonder why they are here?
Message.LocalizedString: These are huge and... on fire. I wonder why they are here?

Message.SourceString: Oh, I must admit I thought you would be completing THE GAUNTLET OF FIRE.
Message.LocalizedString: Oh, I must admit I thought you would be completing THE GAUNTLET OF FIRE.

Message.SourceString: If you don't have time, that's fine, obviously. But if you do have time, then four thumbs up.
Message.LocalizedString: If you don't have time, that's fine, obviously. But if you do have time, then four thumbs up.

Message.SourceString: Go out there on your magic carpet, find four pedestals that look like giant black blocks, and tag them before coming back.
Message.LocalizedString: Go out there on your magic carpet, find four pedestals that look like giant black blocks, and tag them before coming back.

Message.SourceString: Meanwhile, I'm going to shout your name and periodically punch the air!
Message.LocalizedString: Meanwhile, I'm going to shout your name and periodically punch the air!

Message.SourceString: Out there, around the Burning Spire, are four pedestals. They're giant black blocks with fire on top - you can't miss them. You are going to touch the four pedestals in any order and then come back to me.
Message.LocalizedString: Out there, around the Burning Spire, are four pedestals. They're giant black blocks with fire on top - you can't miss them. You are going to touch the four pedestals in any order and then come back to me.

Message.SourceString: Um, could you make some room for me to hop in your pockets? It's crowded in there.
Message.LocalizedString: Um, could you make some room for me to hop in your pockets? It's crowded in there.

Message.SourceString: Right, I think I've learned enough from you. I'm ready to be accepted by my people. I'm going to the Cave of Screams, to the west behind the sunken pyramid.
Message.LocalizedString: Right, I think I've learned enough from you. I'm ready to be accepted by my people. I'm going to the Cave of Screams, to the west behind the sunken pyramid.

Message.SourceString: OH NO YOU DIDN'T! Calm as you like, you just sauntered over to the pedestals, touched them, and came back to me! Legend. Absolute legend.
Message.LocalizedString: OH NO YOU DIDN'T! Calm as you like, you just sauntered over to the pedestals, touched them, and came back to me! Legend. Absolute legend.

Message.SourceString: Come see how I do! There's a KotHaar Bouncer there, guarding the entrance. He will ask for a password.
Message.LocalizedString: Come see how I do! There's a KotHaar Bouncer there, guarding the entrance. He will ask for a password.

Message.SourceString: It is SO simple. Count the total number of words that he says to you. The total number IS the password. See you in there! I'M GOING TO BE A REAL KOTHAAR!
Message.LocalizedString: It is SO simple. Count the total number of words that he says to you. The total number IS the password. See you in there! I'M GOING TO BE A REAL KOTHAAR!

Message.SourceString: Hello hello! Do you remember me? It's the KotHaar, Zi!
Message.LocalizedString: Hello hello! Do you remember me? It's the KotHaar, Zi!

Message.SourceString: Halt! This place is not for your eyes. Turn back.
Message.LocalizedString: Halt! This place is not for your eyes. Turn back.

Message.SourceString: Halt! Speak the password to me, stranger, or you shall not pass.
Message.LocalizedString: Halt! Speak the password to me, stranger, or you shall not pass.

Message.SourceString: Oh my, OH MY, it's a human! Look at how long and weird-looking you are! You're like half a spider.
Message.LocalizedString: Oh my, OH MY, it's a human! Look at how long and weird-looking you are! You're like half a spider.

Message.SourceString: The KotHaar Bouncer snorts.
Message.LocalizedString: The KotHaar Bouncer snorts.

Message.SourceString: The KotHaar Bouncer snorts.
Message.LocalizedString: The KotHaar Bouncer snorts.

Message.SourceString: Hrmmm. Not quite.
Message.LocalizedString: Hrmmm. Not quite.

Message.SourceString: You misunderstand, human. We do not speak numbers as you do.
Message.LocalizedString: You misunderstand, human. We do not speak numbers as you do.

Message.SourceString: Think like a KotHaar. Take this book and return when you can count… properly.
Message.LocalizedString: Think like a KotHaar. Take this book and return when you can count… properly.

Message.SourceString: Ugh. Humans and their tiny pockets. Come back when you have space for what I give you.
Message.LocalizedString: Ugh. Humans and their tiny pockets. Come back when you have space for what I give you.

Message.SourceString: Halt! Speak the password to me, stranger, or you shall not pass.
Message.LocalizedString: Halt! Speak the password to me, stranger, or you shall not pass.

Message.SourceString: The KotHaar Bouncer snorts.
Message.LocalizedString: The KotHaar Bouncer snorts.

Message.SourceString: Human. I despair. Remember the numbering book that I gave you?
Message.LocalizedString: Human. I despair. Remember the numbering book that I gave you?

Message.SourceString: I thought humans would shrivel up in the Scorch, but LOOK at you. The name is KotHaar-Hok-Zi, but you can call me Zi. And, unlike you, I...I'm not as well suited to the Scorch.
Message.LocalizedString: I thought humans would shrivel up in the Scorch, but LOOK at you. The name is KotHaar-Hok-Zi, but you can call me Zi. And, unlike you, I...I'm not as well suited to the Scorch.

Message.SourceString: Correct, human who is clearly not a KotHaar.
Message.LocalizedString: Correct, human who is clearly not a KotHaar.

Message.SourceString: I see you have reversed the forging process, KotHaar-Hok-Zi.
Message.LocalizedString: I see you have reversed the forging process, KotHaar-Hok-Zi.

Message.SourceString: I did, with help from the adventurer. Um, after some consideration, I have decided that I am not going to be a KotHaar after all.
Message.LocalizedString: I did, with help from the adventurer. Um, after some consideration, I have decided that I am not going to be a KotHaar after all.

Message.SourceString: The Bouncer looks from side to side, as if checking if someone is watching.
Message.LocalizedString: The Bouncer looks from side to side, as if checking if someone is watching.

Message.SourceString: Good for you, little one. Grab this opportunity with all four hands. I wish I had done the same.
Message.LocalizedString: Good for you, little one. Grab this opportunity with all four hands. I wish I had done the same.

Message.SourceString: Or, at least, I would if you had any space in your piddling human pockets. Empty some space and come back to me.
Message.LocalizedString: Or, at least, I would if you had any space in your piddling human pockets. Empty some space and come back to me.

Message.SourceString: Pass, human.
Message.LocalizedString: Pass, human.

Message.SourceString: OH MY KILN I just had a brilliant idea! You can teach me how to survive in the desert!
Message.LocalizedString: OH MY KILN I just had a brilliant idea! You can teach me how to survive in the desert!

Message.SourceString: Bring me 1 cactus steak and 3 raw beltfish. Show me how to gather life from the sand like a desert witch! A sand-witch, hehe!
Message.LocalizedString: Bring me 1 cactus steak and 3 raw beltfish. Show me how to gather life from the sand like a desert witch! A sand-witch, hehe!

Message.SourceString: And you, human - you have been a friend to this little KotHaar. I wish to give you a trophy from Zi's discarded body.
Message.LocalizedString: And you, human - you have been a friend to this little KotHaar. I wish to give you a trophy from Zi's discarded body.

Message.SourceString: Nothing interesting happens.
Message.LocalizedString: Nothing interesting happens.

Message.SourceString: He was accepted by the KotHaar, but on one condition: his core must be forged into a new body. And that body is controlled by Fuzan.
Message.LocalizedString: He was accepted by the KotHaar, but on one condition: his core must be forged into a new body. And that body is controlled by Fuzan.

Message.SourceString: It would serve you well, human, to read the guide I gave you.
Message.LocalizedString: It would serve you well, human, to read the guide I gave you.

Message.SourceString: It's why I am out here, actually. I was told that I couldn't be a real KotHaar, on account of my frailty. But it's only temporary! I am going to prove that I am definitely NOT the weak-link they say I am.
Message.LocalizedString: It's why I am out here, actually. I was told that I couldn't be a real KotHaar, on account of my frailty. But it's only temporary! I am going to prove that I am definitely NOT the weak-link they say I am.

Message.SourceString: Thank you thank you thank you. You will NOT regret this. Okay, what do survival people do in the desert? Ah, yes, they make their own food!
Message.LocalizedString: Thank you thank you thank you. You will NOT regret this. Okay, what do survival people do in the desert? Ah, yes, they make their own food!

Message.SourceString: It would serve you well, human, to read the guide I gave you.
Message.LocalizedString: It would serve you well, human, to read the guide I gave you.

Message.SourceString: And you answered that without even reading the leaflet I gave you. Almost as if you were guided to the answer by some invisible force.
Message.LocalizedString: And you answered that without even reading the leaflet I gave you. Almost as if you were guided to the answer by some invisible force.

Message.SourceString: Zi is inside. But I warn you - he is changed.
Message.LocalizedString: Zi is inside. But I warn you - he is changed.

Message.SourceString: He was accepted by the KotHaar, but on one condition: his core must be forged into a new body. And that body is controlled by Fuzan.
Message.LocalizedString: He was accepted by the KotHaar, but on one condition: his core must be forged into a new body. And that body is controlled by Fuzan.

Message.SourceString: Of course! You are busy! Very busy! I will wait here and die and become one with the desert.
Message.LocalizedString: Of course! You are busy! Very busy! I will wait here and die and become one with the desert.

Message.SourceString: None shall pass, by command of Fuzan.
Message.LocalizedString: None shall pass, by command of Fuzan.

Message.SourceString: You hear screams from beyond the door. Yeah, this is the Cave of Screams alright.
Message.LocalizedString: You hear screams from beyond the door. Yeah, this is the Cave of Screams alright.

Message.SourceString: You step away from the door.
Message.LocalizedString: You step away from the door.

Message.SourceString: You pick up something small, black and buzzing with energy.
Message.LocalizedString: You pick up something small, black and buzzing with energy.

Message.SourceString: OH MY KILN you were amazing! I was all like 'ARGH I AM IN THE GRIP OF FUZAN!' and you were like 'I WILL SAVE YOU, ZI!'.
Message.LocalizedString: OH MY KILN you were amazing! I was all like 'ARGH I AM IN THE GRIP OF FUZAN!' and you were like 'I WILL SAVE YOU, ZI!'.

Message.SourceString: Did you bring me the things that you gathered from the desert?
Message.LocalizedString: Did you bring me the things that you gathered from the desert?

Message.SourceString: No? Oh - not a bother. You have so much to do, being an adventurer and all.
Message.LocalizedString: No? Oh - not a bother. You have so much to do, being an adventurer and all.

Message.SourceString: I'll just sit here and slowly erode into nothingness.
Message.LocalizedString: I'll just sit here and slowly erode into nothingness.

Message.SourceString: You came back! And you brought the cactus steak and the fish belts!
Message.LocalizedString: You came back! And you brought the cactus steak and the fish belts!

Message.SourceString: This is all too much. Okay, okay, next up is THE GAUNTLET OF FIRE! You're going to show me how to navigate lava and also be a kickass hero.
Message.LocalizedString: This is all too much. Okay, okay, next up is THE GAUNTLET OF FIRE! You're going to show me how to navigate lava and also be a kickass hero.
